title: A great time relaxing with friends in Seville
text:
We did a group yoga class for my sister’s EVJF in Seville with Jennifer from Solar Yoga, and it was an unforgettable experience! 

Jennifer is a gentle, professional and attentive teacher who has created a relaxing and joyful atmosphere. 

The setting was beautiful and the course perfectly adapted to our group. A moment of well-being and connection that we will all remember. 

Thank you again Jennifer!
author: 911marinel
